title: WorkflowDefinition
description: Represents a type of object ("entity") in the workflow system

name.description: Short internal name of the entity type

title.description: Localized title of the entity type

titlePlural.description: Localized plural of the entity type title

index.description: Integer indicating the tab order in the instance page

isAlwaysVisible.description: Always show this entity type to the user, even if the user has no rights

inheritsFrom.description: Name of the entity type this type inherits from

instanceTitle.description: Template for the title of an instance

properties.description: Dictionary of properties for this entity type

events.description: Dictionary of event definitions for this entity type

globalActions.description: List of actions for this entity type

steps.description: List of step names for this entity type

fields.description: List of fields for this entity type

isEmbedded.description: Indicated whether this entity type is stored as an embedded document in the parent instance

seedData.description: Data to be automatically created on app start. Will match existing data by external ID

PropertyDefinition.title: PropertyDefinition
PropertyDefinition.description: Represents a property of an entity type (which can also be used as a propertyDefinition in a form)

visibility.description: Set if this propertyDefinition is hidden from users without extra permissions

layout.description: Specific layout options for the data type

shortText.description: Localized short propertyDefinition text to shown in results

type.description:
Data type of the propertyDefinition. Can be a primitive type String, Int, Double, DateTime, Date, User, Currency, File, Boolean
            or a reference to a value set or another entity type. Use [Type] to indicate an array and Type! to indicate
            a required value.

default.description: Expression used to initialize this property when an instance is created without a value.

description.description: Localized extended description text for the propertyDefinition.

inheritedRoles.description: To be used for properties that refer to other entities. List of roles that is inherited from the target instance.

condition.description: Condition that determines if the propertyDefinition should be shown

validation.description: Condition that determines if the value is valid

filter.description: Condition used for filtering reference choices

onSave.description: Effect that is run whenever a value is changed for this property

hideInResults.description: Determines if the propertyDefinition should be hidden in the results table

allowsExternalUsers.description: Determines if the propertyDefinition allows external users

rubric.description: Rubric entries that describe grading criteria for this property

sources.description: If set, this question is included in a form only when editing a matching property

linkedTo.description: The name of another property this property is linked to.

type.description: Set if the field should be shown as dropdown or radio list

multiline.description: Set if the field should be a multiline text field

allowAttachments.description: Set if the text field should allow attachments

variant.description: Renders the string field as a specific input (e.g. email or phone) with matching validation

type.description: Sets if the table should allow inline editing or not

description.description: Localized extended description text for the choice

condition.description: Condition that determines if the choice should be shown

not.description: If true, this condition is inverted

event.description: Check if an event has occurred

oneOf.description: Check if a date has passed
Check if a deadline has passed

message.description: Message that is shown then the condition is not, for use in form validation

Value.title: Value
Value.description:
Represents a value comparison. Use this to compare two properties, or to compare a property to a fixed literal value
            (prefix a string value with an equals sign to indicate a literal value)

equal.description: Value the property should be equal to. If this is a literal string, it must be prefixed with an equals sign

lessThan.description: Value the property should be less than

greaterThan.description: Value the property should be greater than

greaterThanOrEqual.description: Value the property should be greater than or equal to

in.description: Array the property should be in

isEmpty.description: If set, check whether the property is empty

id.description: Id of the event to check for

name.description: Optional effect name, used to refer to outputs of this effect

condition.description: Condition that determines if this trigger is active

oneOf.description: Do an http call to an external service
Set a property on the current instance
Redirect the user to an url
Create external login access for the assigned user or users of a workflow role

delay.description: Run the effect after this delay, e.g. 2d, 4h or 30m

to.description: Recipients: each entry is a property lookup (User or [User]), a literal email address, or a template.

type.description: Toast type to show in the frontend

message.description: Toast message to show in the frontend

url.description: Template for the url to call

value.description: Expression that determines the value of the property

role.description: Name of the workflow role/property that holds the target user or users

type.description:
Determines how this field is used in the calculation. For Average, set a weight to use it in a weighted average.
            For Sum, the weight is ignored.
Determines what kind of results are shown for this field

source.description: For Type = Source, this determines which source property to use

suppresses.description: List of event names that are suppressed when this event occurs. Only the most recent event will be suppressed.

resetParentStep.description: When declared on a step event, restarts the sequential parent of the declaring step; the suppression rules are generated from the effective hierarchy (see docs/reset-parent-step.md).

name.description: Internal name of the action. Required for actions of type execute

label.description: Localized label of the action as shown in the user interface

roles.description: List of roles that can perform this action

form.description: Target form for View / Submit / Edit actions

forms.description: List of target forms for View / Submit / Edit actions

collections.description: List of target collections for ??? (not yet implemented)

propertyDefinition.description: Target propertyDefinition for the view hidden propertyDefinition action

condition.description: Condition that determines whether the action is permitted

onAction.description: List of effects to run for an Execute action

steps.description: List of steps during which this action is permitted

noAutoOpenForm.description: When true, the submit form does not automatically even if it is the only submit action in the step

property.description: Target property for the CreateRelatedInstance action

userProperty.description: Weird thing, maybe we should get rid of this?

limit.description: Weird thing, maybe we should get rid of this?

href.description: Url the field should refer to

default.description: Default value to use if the target is empty

condition.description: Conditions that determines if the field is included in the DTO

endDate.description: Target step the field should show the end date of

currentStep.description: If true, display the current step in this field

href.description: Url the field should refer to

default.description: Default value to use if the target is empty

condition.description: Conditions that determines if the field is included in the DTO

endDate.description: Target step the field should show the end date of

currentStep.description: If true, display the current step in this field

RelatedUserGroup.title: RelatedUserGroup
RelatedUserGroup.description: Defines a named group of related users

AssessmentConfiguration.title: AssessmentConfiguration
AssessmentConfiguration.description: Configuration for the assessment of the entity

parts.description: The parts that together make up the assessment

oneOf.description: Property to indicate the final grade type

gradeGap.description: Determines whether grades between 5 and 6 are allowed

name.description: Internal name of the assessment part

title.description: Localized title of the assessment part

weight.description: Weight of this part in the final grade calculation

maximumDiscrepancy.description: Show a warning if the discrepancy between the scores is larger than or equal to this value

sources.description: The assessor sources that contribute to this part

AssessmentSource.title: AssessmentSource
AssessmentSource.description: An assessor source within an assessment part, referencing a property by name

name.description: Name of the property (assessor) that provides the score for this part

weight.description: Relative weight of this source within the assessment part. Defaults to 1.
